metadata.title: HBMs beyond Nvidia: Why Samsung has the most to gain from Jensen's exit

content.text:
With Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepping down, market observers expect the AI chip landscape to gradually move away from Nvidia's near-monopoly, with HBM demand shifting toward non-Nvidia buyers such as Google and AMD...
